animewaw.together.description: Shown in a watch-together room next to the number of people watching, e.g. "Watching together · 3".

animewaw.buttonWatchTogether.description: Button that opens the watch-together room the user is in. Must be 32 characters or less.

animewaw.top100.description: Shown when the user is viewing the list of the 100 best rated anime.
